grammar.title: there is/are 的疑问句与否定句
grammar.structure: 疑问句：Be + there + 名词?  否定句：There + be + not (any)/no + 名词
grammar.definition: there + be 变疑问句把 be 与 there 互换位置；变否定在 be 后加 not(any) 或 no。Is there a…? / Are there any…? / No, there aren't any…
grammar.usage: 询问或否定某处存在某物。

examples.en: Are there any books in the room? No, there aren't any books in the room.
examples.zh: 房间里有一些书吗？不，房间里没有任何书。

examples.en: Is there a dirty fork on the plate? No, there isn't one.
examples.zh: 碟子上有个脏叉子吗？没有，一个也没有。

grammar.title: some 与 any 的用法
grammar.structure: 肯定句用 some；疑问句/否定句用 any
grammar.definition: some 表「某些」（不全部），用于肯定句；any 表不确定数量，用于含 not 的否定句或预期否定回答的疑问句。二者作用常像 a/an 的复数。
grammar.usage: 替代 a/an 的复数/不可数形式。

examples.en: There are some magazines on the television.
There aren't any spoons in the cupboard.

questions.q: Why does the text use 'some magazines' (some) but the exercise asks 'Are there any books' (any)?
questions.zh: 为什么课文用 some magazines，而练习却问 Are there any books（any）？
questions.a: some is used in affirmative statements; any is used in questions and negatives. The text describes what exists (affirmative → some), while the drill asks about existence (question → any).
questions.aZh: some 用于肯定陈述，any 用于疑问/否定句。课文在描述存在（肯定→some），操练在询问存在（疑问→any）。
questions.hint: 记住口诀：肯定 some，疑问/否定 any。

questions.q: Are there any books in the room? No, there aren't any books. There are some magazines. Where are they? They're on the television. / Are there any ties on the floor? No, there aren't any ties. There are some shoes. Where are they? They're near the bed.

questions.hint: 疑问/否定用 any，肯定补述用 some。

translation:
史密斯夫人的客厅很大。
客厅里有台电视机。
电视机靠近窗子。
电视机上放着几本杂志。
客厅里有张桌子。
桌上放着几份报纸。
客厅里有几把扶手椅。
那些扶手椅靠近桌子。
客厅里有台立体声音响。
音响靠近门。
音响上面有几本书。
客厅里有几幅画。
画挂在墙上。
title: Mrs. Smith's living room / Are there any …?
subtitle: 史密斯夫人的客厅 / 有一些……吗？

lead.question: 描述客厅里「有一些杂志在电视机上」「有一些扶手椅在桌子旁」，英语的 some 和 any 分别用在什么句子里？
lead.warmup: 第 27 课继续房间描述，但物品变多了、用复数：There is a television… There are some magazines… There are some armchairs… 注意 some 用于肯定句。第 28 课反转成疑问句和否定句：Are there any books? No, there aren't any. There are some magazines. 关键就是 some（肯定）vs any（疑问/否定）。先看图，试着用 Are there any…? 问客厅里有没有书。
goals: 能用 There are + 复数名词 描述存在多个物品
能区分 some（肯定句）与 any（疑问/否定句）
能用 Are there any …? 提问存在，并用 No, there aren't any. / There are some … 回答
能用 Where are they? 追问位置
lead.summary: 第 27 课描述史密斯夫人的客厅：There is a television, There are some magazines/armchairs/pictures，并用 near the window/table/door、on the wall 说明位置。第 28 课把 there are 变成疑问句与否定句，操练 some/any 的对比：Are there any books? No, there aren't any. There are some magazines. Where are they? They're on the television.
lead.tips: ① There are 接复数名词；② some 用于肯定句（There are some magazines），any 用于疑问句和否定句（Are there any…? / There aren't any…）；③ near 表示「靠近」，on the wall 在墙上；④ 回答 Are there any…? 否定用 No, there aren't any + 名词，再补 There are some + 其他；⑤ Where are they? 追问位置，they 指代前文复数名词。
